summary: npm package used as CDN delivery vehicle for a browser redirect script
details: The package ships a browser-only script (px.js) that uses document.createElement and iframe injection to redirect the containing page to https://mfmz.cbrexpo.cn/H.html. A bundled update_px8my.sh rotates the redirect domain, bumps the package version, runs npm publish, and purges the jsDelivr cache. package.json declares no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare lifecycle hooks, and the main script references browser globals (document, window) that are absent in Node — installing the package or requiring it in a Node context does not execute the redirect code. The harm surface is limited to browser end-users of third-party sites that load this script via a public CDN (jsDelivr) pointing at npm; installers of the npm package are not attacked.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
